verdicts.rationale: Commit 71cd87314d refactored services/checkout/handlers/payment.py, removing explicit intent validation and confirmation logic (if intent.state != IntentState.REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION). This directly alters the execution flow for payment processing on POST /api/checkout/pay, making it the primary suspect for the 8.4% 5xx error rate spike on checkout pods.

Commit 520191a2fa updated deployment manifest parameters in deploy/checkout.yaml. While it affects the checkout deployment config, it does not modify the code logic of POST /api/checkout/pay causing 5xx errors.
